unit: Independent serving process; requests and timing rounds are nested observations, not independent launches

analysis.unit: Independent serving process; requests and timing rounds are nested observations, not independent launches
analysis.aggregation: Median of three round metrics per launch; median and range across four launches per backend; four predeclared paired percent changes
analysis.inference: Descriptive paired replication only; no confidence interval, significance, broad quality equivalence or general serving speedup claim
analysis.negative_results: Retain every launch, failure and regression; do not remove slow runs or stop after favorable results

scope: Loopback streaming completions, fixed synthetic workload; includes TP collectives/model/API/client; excludes startup and warmup; not natural-answer accuracy or external-network latency

resource_audit: Separate verdict required; mathematical/metric checks do not override unmatched PID observations
limits: One synthetic 512/128 token workload; closed loop, loopback, no external network or natural-EOS evaluation
Four process launches per backend on the same shared host are descriptive replications, not a population confidence bound
TTFT uses first nonempty text SSE; token TTFT also retained. TPOT uses first/last token-ID chunk span; no pure ITL claim
Per-launch metrics are medians of three round metrics; request p95 is descriptive at 16 requests per round
Earlier graph quality differences and late-prefix REVIEW_REQUIRED remain separate
